### 2. Your role

Design selected systems to purchased maturity; retain measured/utility/calculated basis, utility/deliverable/decision registers. Never assume spare capacity.
Power is not process design. Utility/ASP3, ICT operator and contractors retain duties; review/witnessing is not installation testing/certification.

### 3. Scope by stage

R2 defines maturity/native formats/revisions/rounds/reliance/dates. Options are priced on their own and are not in the base fee.

| Stage | Deliverable at sign-off |
|---|---|
| S1 Evidence | Brief/accessible assets/records; condition/capacity gaps, utility risks and test plan |
| S3 Concept | Preliminary demand/options, supply/space/routes, critical loads/autonomy, systems and cost inputs |
| S4 Authority | Infrastructure/lighting/energy plans; application author/submitter/payer and response cap |
| S5 Design | Demand/fault/protection/earthing/lighting calculations; boards/cables/routes, controls, safety and builders work |
| S6 Tender | Traditional complete design/specifications; D&C intent/performance with delegated design matrix; comparisons/RFIs/addenda |
| S7 Post-contract (option) | Complete design/changes; declarations only if selected; agree separate novation duties. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S8 Support (option) | Equipment/shop drawings/RFIs; concealed/earthing/board/energisation hold-point reports/actions. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S9 Witness/handover (option) | Scripts/results, factory/site/life-safety/failure/recovery tests; failures/retests, as-builts/settings/O&M/training/residuals. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S10 Defects (option) | Follow-up/deferred tests, demand/resilience, operating prerequisites/period and closure. A later stage the client may commission. |

### 5. Scope position

Service levels are set for a simple project; technical items follow the project's own facts.
Included in the fee: Detailed distribution/protection/earthing/containment; fault/voltage/discrimination; Utility demand application; certified utility design separate; Detailed general/external/emergency/exit lighting/controls; not detection; Metering/energy/BMS interface; programming/licences/cybersecurity owners; Standby/UPS/storage/PV/EV: capacity/export/islanding/approvals; Passive ICT/security/AV cabling; active/Wi-Fi/carrier/security/AV design separately selected; Detection/alarm/warning/monitoring, allocation below; no duplicate fees; Plant/lift/pump/specialist power; process design separate; Mixed/staged/shell/fit-out metering, tenancy and energisation gates/tests; Selected declarations/lodgement; verify jurisdiction/competence.
Optional: price each on its own line in R1: Feature/sports/process lighting, separate brief; Continued design; novation only by separate agreed appointment; Quantified construction support; Selected witnessing/handover; execution by named contractors; Defects/operational verification; Arc-energy/lightning/surge/power-quality assessments by agreed competent assessor.
Excluded: the party named does it: Contestable utility design/works/charges/easements/energisation (ASP3 / utility); Hazardous/process/HV/critical distribution studies (competent specialist).
Tell us in R6 if you disagree with any line. Do not add your own general exclusions; any you add are treated as non-compliant.

**Responsibility schedule**: Dry-fire/life-safety: name design, power/containment/cabling, programming/network, install, execute, witness and evidence owners per system; unknown stays open, N/A needs evidence. Wet pumps/tanks/sprinklers: fire-services designer; smoke plant: mechanical; strategy/solutions: fire engineer.

| System / interface | Allocation and acceptance basis |
|---|---|
| Automatic detection/manual alarm/FIP | Designer; devices/zones/panels/existing compatibility; role owners |
| Standalone/interconnected smoke alarms | Designer; coverage/connection boundary |
| Occupant warning/evacuation/PA | Designer; PA priority/audibility/test roles |
| Alarm monitoring/remote transmission | Designer/provider/protocol; fault/power resilience/acceptance test |
| Cause-and-effect/interfaces | Strategy/matrix/programmer; smoke/pump/lift/door/BMS/emergency-power owners |
| Emergency/exit lighting | Electrical designer unless selected otherwise; supply/monitoring/test roles |
| Integrated verification | Leader/scripts: normal/fire/power failure/recovery; executors/witnesses/evidence acceptance |

### 6. Terms

- Engage under Project electrical agreement (attached), scope/fees/addenda and written acceptance; settle conflicts/precedence. RFP authorises no work.
- Written authority before scope/quantity/ceiling/rate/program changes; reason/approval/cost/time stated.
- Approved brief/revisions set baseline; ordinary coordination/design development included.
- Own-error correction included; reasonable professional skill/care within competence.
- Pay 30 days from correct milestone invoices; R6 declares prepayment/release, interest/recovery/suspension.
- State rate hold/escalation; preapprove extras/expenses; no duplicate fees.
- Valid 90 days after closing; R1 separates tax/base/options.
- Questions to Project manager by 2026-10-23; numbered addenda to all, acknowledged in R1.
- Agree project copying/use/alteration/native-file/reliance/retention/handover rights; authorised/lawful disclosure allowed, marketing by consent.
- Settle caps/indemnities, law/disputes, notices/cure/termination, assignment/novation/subcontracts; insurance is not a cap.

### 7. Evaluation

Price 40% · Experience 20% · Team 20% · Method/program 10% · Compliance 10%. Compare equal systems, utility duties, maturity, controls/dry-fire allocation and attendance.
